rows: PA612-ESD is an ESD-safe nylon material engineered to offer outstanding thermal and mechanical properties, making it ideal for sensitive electronic applications.
Fiberon™ PA612-ESD is sensitive to moisture and should always be stored and used under dry conditions (relative humidity below 20%).
Normally, the life of a brass nozzle would be approximately 9h.
Abrasion of the brass nozzle happens frequently when printing Fiberon™ PA612-ESD.
A wear-resistance nozzle, such as hardened steel and ruby nozzle, is highly recommended to be used with Fiberon™ PA612-ESD.
Otherwise, the support structure can be permanently bonded to the model.
If Fiberon™ PA612-ESD is used as the support material for itself, please remove the support structure before excessive moisture absorption.
Exact-product maker claim only; printed geometry, test method, service load and lifetime unstated. No suitability or qualification pass.

DuPont's Zytel guide (R-DUPONT-ZYTEL-GUIDE) prints, for the unreinforced PA612 grades Zytel 151L and 153HSL, a density of 1060 kg/m³ (ISO 1183), a melting temperature of 218 °C (ISO 11357-1/-3) and a water absorption, similar to ISO 62, of 1.3 % at equilibrium at 50 % RH and 23 °C and 3 % saturated, immersed at 23 °C, p. 8.

Water or aqueous solutions at high temperature

All polyamides take up water when kept in a moist environment... Irreversible chemical damage to the material can only be caused by water or aqueous solutions at high temperatures. This is referred to as hydrolysis.
Class statement for all polyamides; PA612 is not singled out.
